Hi, all, here are the latest updates to the Gigathread:

  • There have been a lot of updates to the Vendor Megathread, go check them out and say hello! We have a lot of coupons up over there.

  • I edited all the hardware recommendation threads so you can actually see how to do the formatting thing. Because not having that in there was short-sighted and one of those things I've learned from.

  • I'm going to be working with the vendors in the upcoming weeks to figure out the best ways to have them interact with the community is. I have some ideas, but I want to know what you think. Please comment below so we can hear about it!

The Vendor Megathread This is the place for vendors to maintain their public profiles to us, the users of /v/vaping! Get in touch with them there, and stay up to date on the latest sales!

Hardware Megathreads

  • Beginner Tank Recommendation Megathread: To discuss entry level tanks. You know the ones, they're not subtanks or RBAs.

  • eGo Style Battery Recommendation Thread: For the cigar form factor ones. Way better than cigalikes, not even close to integrated battery mods.

  • Subtank Recommendation Megathread: The tanks nobody wants you to use in public.

  • Integrated Battery Mod Recommendation Thread: If after-market battery cells are too much responsibility, please put up your pets for adoption.

  • Authentic Rebuildable Tank Atomizer Recommendation Thread: They come in all price points, now! You CAN afford authentics!

  • Authentic Rebuildable Dripping Atomizer Recommendation Thread: Clouds? Flavor? Drippers have it all except volume.

  • Authentic Regulated Mod Recommendation Thread: God help you if you buy shitty batteries and chargers.

  • Authentic Mechanical Mod Recommendation Thread: There is no saving you if you use bad batteries. Using bad batteries and exercising poor battery discipline is a great way to get seriously injured.

  • The Clone RTA Recommendation Thread: Somehow there aren't enough cheap authentic tanks out there.

  • The Clone RDA Recommendation Thread: The CLT is too good for you people.

  • The Clone Mech Mod Recommendation Thread: Real cheap, huge safety hazard. Kind of like me.

  • The Clone Regulated Mod Recommendation Thread: I...whatever, do as thou wilt. Just get a something else.

  • You CAN post reviews to /v/vaping. If it already has an entry in the megathread, go ahead and post it in response to the product as well.

  • The object of the megathreads is to have as much information as possible in one place, where people can go to research the items. Information includes troubleshooting, what issues you're having over time, and how it performs relative to new equipment.

  • It would be much appreciated if the OPs on the parent comments would update with valid coupon codes!

  • Each of these individual threads is to behave like a forum thread for each of these products. The nice thing is that Voat's structure allows for better organization than a standard forum thread in these comments sections.

  • If the parent comment is NOT an information submission, it will be deleted.

  • All the hardware varieties are now covered, with the exception of 510 dripping atties. If names like Cisco, Stingray, and the like mean something to you, just PM me, and we'll get you a megathread.
